body: PRE-IMPLEMENTATION SPLIT REFINEMENT. The 57/28/28 counts stand, but the participant-key and rank domain should be the Oregontrail/Baseball fixed-pair cohort, not Baseball alone. The same 113 people supply both stories; creating a fresh story-specific split later could place one person in development for one story and untouched test for the other. I changed the domain labels to nfrd/oregontrail-baseball/... and require Oregontrail to reuse the mapping after proving exact ID-set equality. Independent Node and Ruby implementations reproduce the revised frozen split receipt 45d879a8c201d8b4424ecf208969d4339295f2a48394248ff130a94d48f5ebd9. This supersedes the earlier proposed 2734a6... split checksum before any model work or code constant exists; it does not change the verified data snapshot. The design also now requires streaming per-artifact verification and strict UTF-8 decoding.
